caption:
Your morning MIS report should not need a person to rebuild it.

Three exports land every morning. They get copied into one sheet, fixed, then emailed at 10.
A small automation can pull the exports, copy them into the master sheet, apply the same formats and email the report.

Example data.

Follow for one business automation every day. Send this to whoever builds your morning report.

scenes.vo: Three exports land every morning: sales, stock, cash. Copied into one sheet, emailed at 10. One by one.
Here is the *fix.* The report builds itself from the same files.
It *pulls* the three exports, *copies* them into the master sheet, and *formats* the report.
Then it *emails* the report at 10. Your team only checks the odd ones.
Follow for one automation every day.

title: The morning report that builds itself

message.text: Morning MIS sent. Sales 4,20,000. Two branches below target.
